name: Cross Country
tagline: Miles of grit through the SLO hills — one Tiger cross country team.

headCoaches.name: Nancy Steinmaus
headCoaches.bio: Also coaches boys distance for SLOHS Track & Field. Cross country runs as one Tiger program, led by Coach Steinmaus and Coach Berkeland together.

headCoaches.name: Dan Berkeland
headCoaches.bio: Three-time All-American and 1992 National Champion in the 3000m steeplechase for Cal Poly San Luis Obispo, where he graduated in 1996 with a degree in Architecture. Co-founder of The Back Porch Bakery, which serves wholesale bread to over 200 locations across the Central Coast. Began coaching at SLOHS in 2024 as a girls track distance assistant; later took on the head role for girls cross country.
